## ColumnDefinition.(constructor)

> This API is provided as a beta preview for developers and may change based on feedback that we receive. Do not use this API in a production environment.
> 

Columns are normally created by the [Blueprint](./database.blueprint.md) methods; construct one directly only when building a blueprint by hand.

**Signature:**

```typescript
constructor(name: string, type: ColumnType, options?: Partial<ColumnAttributes>);
```
